# Recruiting Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard gives the Template talent acquisition team a daily view of hiring pipeline health, open roles, and time-to-hire performance. It supports recruiters, hiring managers, and TA leads in spotting stalled candidates, bottlenecked stages, and roles at risk of missing their target start date.

## Key Metrics
- Open Roles: 18
- Candidates in Pipeline: 142
- Interviews This Week: 24
- Offers Extended: 6

## Insights
- Engineering and Sales drive 70% of open headcount; Engineering has the longest time-to-hire
- Offer acceptance rate is tracking at 82% — within the healthy band for competitive roles
- Screening-stage drop-off is elevated versus last quarter; sourcer calibration review recommended
